title: The six-month wait before a foreign dependant is covered
alt: Notice stating that foreign nationals and overseas Koreans who entered Korea from 3 April 2024 must reside in Korea for six months before becoming a dependant, with listed exceptions
note: For anyone who entered Korea on or after 3 April 2024, six months of domestic residence is required before they can be registered as a dependant. The exceptions take effect immediately on entry: a spouse and minor children, and a set of residence statuses the notice names individually — study (D-2), general training for primary and secondary students (D-4-3), non-professional employment (E-9), permanent residence (F-5) and marriage migration (F-6), alongside residence-purpose status.
redaction: Nothing removed. Standard guidance printed on the notice, with no identifying information.
